equipment.body: scales and layered frost-cloth robe with Norse rune trim
equipment.head: horned rune crown
equipment.legs: wrapped scale skirt with braided sash panels

directions.up: Back view of a tall naga sprite with a long ember-red serpentine mane flowing down the spine. The horned rune crown sits above broad shoulders, and the robe back shows Norse knot trim in pixel bands. The tail tapers under layered scale panels and braided sash details.
directions.down: Front view shows a fierce naga mage with narrow golden eyes, a small serpent-like face, and a glowing rune crown. The chest robe opens into scale armor and frost-cloth layers, with an amber amulet at the collar. The coiled tail and wrapped skirt read clearly in top-down chibi proportions.
directions.left: Left profile shows a sleek serpent head with ember-red mane trailing behind the neck, one golden eye visible, and a raised flame staff in the left hand. The robe drapes over a curved torso, while the scaled tail and sash panels create a strong S-shaped silhouette in pixel form.
directions.right: Right profile mirrors the naga mage with the same horned crown, narrow eye, and flowing red mane. The staff is held in the right hand, angled forward. Layered robe cloth, rune trim, and segmented tail scales remain visible, keeping the sprite readable from the top-down side angle.
